# mistershell_canary_alert_rule (Resource)

Manages a MisterShell canary alert rule. Requires MisterShell 2.1 or newer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mistershell_canary_alert_rule" "example" {
  name          = "site-canary-alerts"
  enabled       = true
  location_ids  = [var.location_id]
  service_types = ["ssh"]
  log           = true
  notify        = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name.

### Optional

- `canary_ids` (Dynamic) Canary ids. Accepts a native Terraform value.
- `discard` (Boolean) Discard.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled.
- `event_codes` (Dynamic) Event codes. Accepts a native Terraform value.
- `forward` (Boolean) Forward.
- `location_ids` (Dynamic) Location ids. Accepts a native Terraform value.
- `log` (Boolean) Log.
- `notify` (Boolean) Notify.
- `service_types` (Dynamic) Service types. Accepts a native Terraform value.
- `src_cidrs` (Dynamic) Src cidrs. Accepts a native Terraform value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identity. Import using this ID; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `position` (Number) Position.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mistershell_canary_alert_rule.example 123
```
